title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-07-12
lineage: all transfers and work performed in the 24 bit realm Weiss-Saracon for 16 BIT 44.1kHz; SBE Free, Flac Level 8 with TLH, Meta Data with Tag & Rename
taper: Mystery Reel of an unknown audience recording uncovered  and shared by LL member Cloverman, which he sent to Matt Smith for his great reel transfer work.  The handwriting on the reel case is thought to be Latvala's, no more is known.

ai_review.summary: Strong acoustic show highlighted by Attics and How Long Blues, captured on a decent but not clearly identified source.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the acoustic portion of this unknown‑date show – especially the beauty of “Attics,” the surprise “How Long Blues,” and an electrifying ending that sent everyone dancing. The recording is described only vaguely as a “definite C” tape, suggesting decent but not pristine sound quality, yet it doesn’t detract from the overall enjoyment.

ai_rating.rationale: Show is praised for standout acoustic songs and atmosphere (≈4.5/5) while recording quality is only modestly described, lowering the overall confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer calls the sound a “definite C,” implying a cassette‑type source with acceptable clarity but not high‑fidelity; no major issues reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Acoustic set builds nicely, culminating in an “off the charts” dancing climax; overall pacing and vibe are described as exceptional.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Mentioned singing ("don't murder me") and praised for his vocal presence.
band_member_comments.Keys: Pig Pen is referenced asking for a harmonica, indicating his on‑stage presence.
